knowledgeMaterial.matching: knowledgeNodeId exact; source section/page should overlap the reviewed provenance; do not rediscover pages with embeddings when provenance already exists.

knowledgePractice.matching: Compare required knowledge-node sets per practice. Practice wording may vary semantically; IDs in this Gold are oracle IDs, not production IDs.

practiceDependencies.matching: Evaluate directed prerequisite edges. Extra transitive edges should be flagged as redundant rather than counted as new semantic prerequisites.

outcomes.matching: Evaluate whether required practices are attached to the expected outcome. OUT03/OUT04 are intentionally partial because this is a representative sample.

successCriteria.knowledgeMaterialLinkRecall: 10/10 sampled KnowledgeNodes preserve reviewed source provenance
successCriteria.practiceCoverage: 10/10 sampled KnowledgeNodes map to at least one appropriate Practice
successCriteria.dependencyValidity: Practice graph is acyclic and contains all reviewed direct prerequisite edges
successCriteria.outcomeCoverage: All 7 sampled Practices map to an expected ChapterOutcome
